The team delivers end-to-end solutions, from initial concept to deployment, for startups and enterprises. SwissDevs emphasizes precision, performance, and usability in every product, creating reliable software that supports business growth. Applicants can expect to work with a company focused on modern technologies, quality engineering practices, and long-term client partnerships. This role involves engaging prospective and existing clients to understand their business needs, presenting SwissDevs’ software solutions, and guiding them through the sales cycle from qualification to closing. Prior experience in B2B software or technology sales is highly beneficial; proficiency in English is required, additional languages are a plus.

review_candidates.description: Job Overview The Procurement Specialist (Oracle ERP) is responsible for managing procurement operations, supplier relationships, and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) activities while ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures. The role requires strong hands-on experience in Oracle ERP Procurement modules and provides support for procurement system optimization, reporting, and process improvement initiatives. The ideal candidate will have experience in Oracle ERP implementation, migration, or transformation projects and will serve as a key resource for Oracle-related procurement activities across the organization. Job Description Oracle ERP & Procurement Systems Act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Oracle ERP Procurement processes and provide functional support across procurement operations. Lead and support Oracle ERP implementation, enhancement, upgrade, migration, and digital transformation initiatives. Participate in business requirements gathering, process mapping, data validation, SIT/UAT testing, user training, go-live, and post-go-live support activities. Collaborate with IT, Finance, business stakeholders, and implementation partners to ensure successful delivery of Oracle-related projects. Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize procurement processes and maximize Oracle ERP capabilities. Provide ongoing system support, troubleshooting, and guidance to end users. Procurement Operations Manage end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes, ensuring efficiency, accuracy, and compliance. Process Purchase Requisitions and Purchase Orders in line with company policies and procurement procedures. Support sourcing activities, RFQs, quotation analysis, supplier selection, and procurement evaluation processes. Ensure compliance with procurement governance, Delegation of Authority (DOA), and internal control requirements. Coordinate with internal stakeholders and suppliers to ensure timely execution of procurement activities. Supplier Management Manage supplier onboarding, registration, qualification, and documentation processes. Maintain supplier master data and ensure data accuracy within Oracle ERP. Monitor supplier performance and support supplier risk management initiatives. Serve as the primary point of contact for supplier-related procurement matters and issue resolution. Purchase Order & Invoice Management Administer Purchase Orders, amendments, confirmations, and procurement documentation. Monitor open orders and proactively follow up on delivery commitments and outstanding transactions. Resolve invoice discrepancies, blocked invoices, and procurement-related payment issues. Work closely with Finance and Accounts Payable teams to ensure timely and accurate supplier payments. Reporting, Compliance & Continuous Improvement Prepare procurement reports, dashboards, KPIs, and spend analysis reports. Monitor procurement compliance with company policies, governance standards, and audit requirements. Support internal and external procurement audits. Analyze procurement performance and recommend process improvement opportunities. Contribute to procurement transformation initiatives and operational excellence programs. Job Specification Education Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field. Experience Minimum 3-5 years of experience in Procurement, Purchasing, Procurement Operations, or Procure-to-Pay (P2P) functions. Proven experience in supplier management, purchasing processes, and procurement operations. Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders including Procurement, Finance, IT, and Accounts Payable teams. Oracle ERP Experience (Mandatory - Primary Requirement) Oracle ERP Procurement expertise is the most important requirement for this position. The ideal candidate must have: Extensive hands-on experience with Oracle ERP Procurement modules. Proven involvement in at least one Oracle ERP implementation, migration, upgrade, or transformation project. Strong experience in: Business process mapping Requirements gathering Data migration and validation System Integration Testing (SIT) User Acceptance Testing (UAT) User training and change management Go-live and post-go-live support Strong knowledge of: Oracle Procurement Oracle Purchasing Oracle Supplier Management Oracle Contracts Oracle Master Data Management Experience working directly with Oracle implementation partners, project teams, and business stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle. Technical Skills Advanced knowledge of Oracle ERP Procurement solutions. Strong Microsoft Excel and procurement reporting skills. Experience managing procurement master data and system workflows. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. Preferred Qualifications Oracle ERP certification is highly desirable. Experience supporting Oracle ERP implementation or transformation projects. Professional certifications in Procurement or Supply Chain Management are an added advantage. Mandatory Requirement Only candidates with proven hands-on Oracle ERP Procurement experience and direct involvement in Oracle ERP implementation, migration, upgrade, or transformation projects will be considered. Candidates with general procurement experience but without strong Oracle ERP expertise will not be considered for this role.

review_candidates.description: Parallel Wireless is reimagining mobile networks with innovative, energy-efficient Open RAN solutions. Join us as we lead the future of telecommunications, driving innovation through green and sustainable networks . Learn more about our mission, vision and values . Parallel Wireless is looking for a hands-on systems engineer to join the development of a multi-RAT digital twin for our Open RAN solution. The role will involve contributing to the integration of production RAN software with PHY, channel, UE, traffic, and network models, and supporting the development of simulation capabilities for LTE, 5G NR, and 2G. This is a great opportunity to gain hands-on experience in RAN systems, simulation, and AI/ML within a highly technical environment. What will you do: Contribute to the development of a modular, multi-RAT RAN digital twin covering LTE and 5G NR. Develop and integrate production software components with simulation and analysis tooling using stable and maintainable interfaces. Work with software and system teams to model communication-system behavior, including traffic, mobility, scheduling, interference, and performance KPIs. Support the extension of existing LTE simulation capabilities and reusable components for additional radio technologies. Develop software components and tools in C/C++ and Python for simulation, automation, data processing, and analysis. Support the development and evaluation of AI/ML-based capabilities for communication systems and network optimization. Build datasets, experiment pipelines, and automated analysis tools to evaluate system behavior and algorithm performance. Create reproducible tests and experiments across software builds and algorithm versions using defined scenarios, configurations, and KPIs. Support simulation verification and validation activities, including comparison with lab results and analysis of model behavior. Build automated unit, component, end-to-end, regression, and performance tests and integrate them into CI/CD workflows. Improve simulation speed, usability, observability, and automation so engineering teams can run repeatable experiments independently. Debug issues across C/C++, Python, MATLAB, system software, configuration, and reference measurements. Document assumptions, supported scenarios, limitations, and experiment results in a clear and structured way. Work closely with RAN, PHY, system, AI/ML, automation, and validation teams to turn engineering questions into measurable experiments. What you bring: B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering or an M.Sc. in a relevant field. At least 2 years of hands-on software development experience in communication systems or a related telecom environment. Strong softwar e development skills in C or C++ and Python. Good understanding of communication systems and the ability to learn new technologies and system concepts quickly. Experience working in Linux development environments with Git, automated testing, and modern software development practices. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex technical issues independently. Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with software, system, algorithms, and validation teams. Simulation experience is not required; candidates with strong software and communication-system backgrounds are encouraged to apply. Nice to have: Experience with simulation environments, system-level modelling, or hardware-in-the-loop testing. Knowledge of LTE and/or 5G NR, RAN, modem/PHY, or wireless communication systems. Experience with MATLAB and communication-system simulation or analysis tools. Hands-on experience with scientific computing and data analysis using NumPy, SciPy, pandas, or similar tools. Exposure to AI/ML, time-series analysis, signal processing, or network optimization. Familiarity with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, or other machine-learning frameworks. Knowledge of digital communications and signal processing concepts. Experience with automated testing, containers, CI/CD, or cloud development environments. Familiarity with SDR, radio test equipment, lab automation, or field-log analysis. Parallel Wireless is expanding the ecosystem for Open RAN with the GreenRAN™ energy-efficient Hardware-Agnostic technology. Deployed worldwide, our comprehensive 2G/3G/4G/5G Macro RAN solutions enhance network security while reducing operating expenses. As pioneers of Open RAN, we prioritize innovation, flexibility, and sustainability to help build a more connected, and green networks. Headquartered in the USA with global R&D centers, we are proud to serve over 60 customers worldwide and have been recognized with over 100 industry awards. Our mission is to accelerate GSMA’s Mobile Net Zero initiative by reducing TCO and driving innovation across the telecom ecosystem.Learn more at www.parallelwireless.com . Parallel Wireless embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams representing all backgrounds, with a wide range of perspectives, and empowering industry-leading skills. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.Parallel Wireless does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies or individuals.
